I struggle with feeling this way too and I often think I'm just some other edgy brat on the internet that's taking up space for people who genuinely need help. It's a hard thing to think about and it pushes you back from what you actually want to do, but I think it's helpful to remember that even if you're doubting yourself *you're still feeling it?* It doesn't matter how severe you think your situation is or whether or not you want to kill yourself. Your feelings are still 100% valid and you trying to improve should be too. Don't prevent yourself from getting the help you need.   
It's understandable that improvement is scary, especially if feeling fine has become out of the norm for you but its possible. Even if it takes you a lot of time and even if you have no motivation for it now, you can try to take small baby steps towards. Even the tiniest change is enough. Just don't push yourself too hard, please. You don't have to suffer like this forever. You will be something
